sections.advice: The forest part from Fuel stop near Anmore to Scenic stretch near Pitt Meadows rewards quiet precision. The road may look empty, but surface changes and animals do not care about your schedule.

sections.advice: Photo stop near Ganges → Richmond is shade riding: beautiful, cooler and sometimes slick. Expect damp patches, leaves, gravel and wildlife where the trees meet the road.

Use High point near Langley → Scenic stretch near Pitt Meadows as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.

scenicChapters.title: Sea-to-Sky Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 67 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
